title: Time: Day and Night, Before and After, Days of the Week
seo_title: Grade R Time Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Talk about the passing of time; order regular events from own life; use language such as morning, afternoon, night, yesterday, today and tomorrow; know the days of the week.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade R maths worksheets: day and night, morning and evening, what happens first, days of the week and yesterday, today and tomorrow. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
key_big: Before and after tell the order.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • We wake up in the morning and sleep at night.
  • Before and after tell us the order of things.
  • There are 7 days in a week: Monday to Sunday.
  • Yesterday was before today; tomorrow comes after today.

Examples

Example

We eat breakfast in the …

breakfast is the first meal

Answer: morning

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Morning or eveningMorning comes after waking up.
The orderThink what happens first.
The daysAfter Sunday comes Monday.

items.q: Which happens first in a school day: eat dinner, go to school, eat lunch?

items.e: The day goes in order: go to school, eat lunch, eat dinner. Go to school comes first.

items.q: Which day comes after Monday?
items.e: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, then Monday again. After Monday comes Tuesday.

items.q: Which day comes before Wednesday?
items.e: Count back one day from Wednesday: Tuesday.

items.q: Which day comes after Tuesday?
items.e: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, then Monday again. After Tuesday comes Wednesday.

items.q: Which day is missing?
items.e: The days go in order: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday. The missing day is Wednesday.

items.q: Which day comes after Wednesday?
items.e: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, then Monday again. After Wednesday comes Thursday.

items.q: Which day comes before Friday?
items.e: Count back one day from Friday: Thursday.

items.q: Which day comes after Thursday?

items.q: Which day is missing?
items.e: The days go in order: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday. The missing day is Friday.

items.q: Which two days are the weekend?
items.e: Most children do not go to school on the weekend: Saturday and Sunday.

items.q: Which day comes after Friday?
items.e: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, then Monday again. After Friday comes Saturday.

items.q: Today is Monday. What day will it be tomorrow?
